meta.name: python-appservice-deploy
meta.description: Deploy Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) code to Azure App Service Linux. WHEN: "Flask App Service", "Django App Service", "FastAPI App Service", "deploy Python to App Service". DO NOT USE FOR: Container Apps, Functions, non-Python, Terraform/Bicep/IaC, full infra — use azure-prepare.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将Python应用部署到Azure App Service
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的Python应用需要部署到Azure App Service
copy.tagline_en: Deploy Python apps to Azure App Service
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to deploy Python apps to Azure App Service

howto.what: 它把 Python(Flask/Django/FastAPI)代码部署到 Azure App Service Linux:资源缺失时自动建资源组、App Service 计划和 Web App,设置好启动命令后执行部署,最后打印部署后提示并结束本轮。
howto.when: 当你说「Flask App Service」「Django App Service」等,或要求把 Python 部署到 App Service 时触发。Container Apps、Functions、非 Python、IaC 不适用。

say.text: 把这个 Flask 应用部署到 Azure App Service
say.note: 只会问应用名,其余用默认值

say.text: 用 azd 把我的 FastAPI 项目部署到 App Service
say.note: 检测到 azure.yaml 时走 azd 路径

say.text: 这次部署到 eastus2,应用名叫 myapi
say.note: 其余资源名按应用名推导

howto.what_en: It deploys Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) code to Azure App Service Linux, creating the resource group, plan, and web app if missing, setting startup, then deploying and printing a post-deploy message.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "Flask App Service", "Django App Service" and similar, or ask to deploy Python to App Service. Not for Container Apps, Functions, non-Python, or IaC.

say_en.text: Deploy this Flask app to Azure App Service
say_en.note: Only the app name is asked; the rest uses defaults

say_en.text: Deploy my FastAPI project to App Service with azd
say_en.note: Uses the azd path when azure.yaml is present

say_en.text: Deploy to eastus2 with the app name myapi
say_en.note: Other resource names derive from the app name
